observed_result: File-writing cases have 23/69 intervals above 1.5 times their session median, discard cases1/69. Two later discard cases have no such interval; all three file cases include approximately one-second intervals.
causal_limit: Writing is associated with longer completion intervals in this small fixed-order experiment. It does not prove queue state, the original diagnostic cause, a driver defect, or that all physical frames arrived.
